mentions.name: Mixtape
mentions.description: A programmable, non-realtime audio sample generator and manipulator written in Go with an OpenGL GUI. It introduces a "tape" data type representing a piece of sound, with Forth-like language operators to create and manipulate tapes that can be stitched into songs, stored as separate *.tape files loaded from each other, and cached as WAV output to speed up projects with large tape hierarchies.
